scripts.build:native: mkdir -p build && swiftc -O -framework IOBluetooth -Xlinker -sectcreate -Xlinker __TEXT -Xlinker __info_plist -Xlinker native/Info.plist native/NXBridge.swift -o build/nx-bridge
scripts.install-app: npm run dist && ditto "dist/Nothing X Mac-darwin-arm64/Nothing X Mac.app" "/Applications/Nothing X Mac.app" && echo "Installed to /Applications/Nothing X Mac.app"
scripts.build:native:universal: mkdir -p build && swiftc -O -target arm64-apple-macos13 -framework IOBluetooth -Xlinker -sectcreate -Xlinker __TEXT -Xlinker __info_plist -Xlinker native/Info.plist native/NXBridge.swift -o build/nx-bridge-arm64 && swiftc -O -target x86_64-apple-macos13 -framework IOBluetooth -Xlinker -sectcreate -Xlinker __TEXT -Xlinker __info_plist -Xlinker native/Info.plist native/NXBridge.swift -o build/nx-bridge-x86_64 && lipo -create build/nx-bridge-arm64 build/nx-bridge-x86_64 -output build/nx-bridge && rm build/nx-bridge-arm64 build/nx-bridge-x86_64
scripts.release: npm run build:native:universal && node scripts/package.js --universal && node scripts/release.js
